credentials.description: license key, sent as Authorization: Basic <license key> (the key as is, not base64 of user:password)
website ID of your LengoPay account, sent with the request (body field websiteid, or path segment for get_balance), separate from the license key

example_prompt: List today's LengoPay incoming payments for reconciliation.

websiteid.description: Unique site identifier (Site ID in the LengoPay dashboard).

account.description: Phone number of the payment recipient.

gateway.description: Network used for the payment (e.g. "Orange Money").

gotchas: Returns only Cash In transactions (push to a phone number via cashin_request). For Cash Out transactions via payment URL, use list_transactions.
The account field may be returned as a number or a string depending on the response — normalize with String(account) before use.
